approved_definition_context: ℝ denotes real numbers and ℕ natural numbers starting at zero. Real inverse is totalized with inverse zero equal to zero. Nat.rec z f defines value z at zero and f j (previous value) at j+1. A have-expression in a displayed type is a local abbreviation. The upward-arrow coerces a natural number to a real number; the subscripted ceiling is the natural ceiling, zero for nonpositive arguments. Real.log is the natural logarithm, Real.exp its exponential, and the square root is the nonnegative real square root.
